newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-LATE PANTIC GOAL GIVES ATLETICO HARD-FOUGHT WIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LATE PANTIC GOAL GIVES ATLETICO HARD-FOUGHT WIN.

text.p: Atletico Madrid were forced to wait until seven minutes from time when Yugoslav midfielder Milinko Pantic scored direct from a free-kick to secure a 1-0 win over Widzew Lodz in Group B of the Champions' League on Wednesday.

Pantic, who also scored when Atletico beat Widzew 4-1 in September, curled the ball into the far corner of Maciej Szczesny's net from the edge of the box after substitute Radek Bejbl was sent tumbling by a Polish defender.

The game seemed destined to end in a goalless draw after the two sides squandered a succession of scoring chances throughout a match which never quite had a real edge to it as Atletico were already assured of their place in the last eight and Widzew were already eliminated.

Widzew's night was summed up by an astonishing miss in the last minute by Radoslaw Michalski who broke free of the Atletico defence, ran 35 metres with the ball and with only goalkeeper Jose Molina to beat, sliced his shot wide.

The match was a costly one for Atletico as far as the quarter-finals are concerned. They had Pablo and Kiko booked during the second half and as that was a second booking for both players they will miss the first leg next March.
